details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1150-1153 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `attempt_render_recovery_after_preflight_failure` can skip deterministic rerender recovery for failures that are classified as `non_lint`.
  WHY: Both reviewers say the new `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS:-non_lint` gate blocks rerender for structural/generated-artifact failures, which may be recoverable; severity reflects the highest reported.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1181-1210 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The recovery path’s `PRE_FLIGHT_APPEND_LOG` handling can be inconsistent with `run_preflight_checks`, causing the rerender log to be cleared instead of appended.
  WHY: The reviewer reports that `local PRE_FLIGHT_APPEND_LOG="true"` does not affect the global variable read by `run_preflight_checks`, which can wipe the recovery marker and post-rerender failures.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1194-1200 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Post-rerender failure classification can still see stale log content or otherwise misclassify the second failure.
  WHY: Both reviewers point to the log-isolation/fallback logic around `tmp_log` and `classify_preflight_failure`; one says the fallback can re-scan the full appended log, the other says the slicing mechanism is intended to avoid stale matches.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1150-1153 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3-flash-preview]
  PROBLEM: The `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` gate and the later classification/logging path can leave recovery state inconsistent.
  WHY: The reviewer says the class gate is checked before reclassification and that the function does not update `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` after a rerender failure, which can desynchronize routing/logging state.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1150-1153 | severity=medium | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The new class gate and the log-based classifier can disagree about whether recovery should run.
  WHY: The reviewer says the gate uses the initial failure class while `classify_preflight_failure` re-analyzes the log, which can produce conflicting decisions.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1150-1153 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2]
  PROBLEM: The default used in the gate and the default used in the log message are inconsistent.
  WHY: The reviewer notes `${PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS:-non_lint}` in the check but `${PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS:-unknown}` in the message, which is confusing but not a runtime bug.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1221-1287 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: Several generated-artifact failure cases are classified as `non_lint`, which causes the new recovery gate to skip rerender.
  WHY: The reviewer says missing `docker-compose.test.yml`, `validate.env`, `00_canary.sh`, and similar structural failures are treated as non-recoverable even though deterministic rerender could fix them.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1242-1259 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: Syntax-error cases in `validate.sh` and `validate_driver.sh` are classified as `lint` even though rerender cannot fix them.
  WHY: The reviewer says the gate will allow a wasted rerender attempt on files that are not regenerated by the template renderer.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1678-1803 | severity=medium | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: Additional failure cases such as build-context/dockerfile resolution, mongosh repo violations, and CANARY_TOOLS scope violations are classified in ways that block recovery.
  WHY: The reviewer says these paths end up as `non_lint`, so the recovery path is skipped after the new gate even when regeneration might help.
- tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py:338-380 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The embedded test copy of `attempt_render_recovery_after_preflight_failure` does not include the new `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` guard.
  WHY: All three reviewers say the tests are exercising an older mock of the function, so the suite does not verify the production guard logic.
- tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py:338-380 | severity=medium | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, stepfun_step-3_5-flash]
  PROBLEM: The embedded test stubs do not exercise the new class gating or classification behavior.
  WHY: Both reviewers say the mocks hardcode or bypass the new class/kind routing, leaving skip-recovery and class-specific behavior untested.
- tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py:338-380 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v3_2, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The tests verify old behavior rather than the updated production flow.
  WHY: Both reviewers say the pass is misleading because the embedded function differs from production, so regressions in the new guard could slip through.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1150-1158 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The default used in the `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` check does not match the default used in the log message.
  WHY: The check uses `${PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS:-non_lint}` while the log message uses `${PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS:-unknown}`, which is confusing and could mislead maintainers.
- tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py:338-380 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The embedded copies of `attempt_render_recovery_after_preflight_failure` in the tests do not include the new `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` guard.
  WHY: The reviewer says the tests are validating an older version of the function, so they do not verify the production guard logic and could miss regressions.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1150-1158 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Missing validation-artifact failures are classified as `non_lint`, which skips rerender recovery.
  WHY: The reviewer says missing generated files in template mode may reflect a renderer failure that rerendering could fix, though they note this may also be intentional.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v3_2 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1146-1160 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` is not updated after a recovery rerun, leaving the failure state inconsistent.
  WHY: The reviewer says the rerender path updates `KIND` and `REASON` but not `CLASS`, which can confuse later routing or logging.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1189-1193 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The recovery log-isolation flow can still leave the preflight classification state interleaved or stale.
  WHY: The reviewer says appended logs and the temporary slice can produce inconsistent summary variables if the rerun fails again.
- tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py:338-380 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The embedded test harness still lacks the production `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` guard.
  WHY: The reviewer says production now requires the class guard, but the test mock does not cover it, so the suite can pass without exercising the new logic.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3-flash-preview ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1181-1210 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The recovery path can clear the rerender log because `PRE_FLIGHT_APPEND_LOG` is set locally while `run_preflight_checks` reads the global variable.
  WHY: The reviewer says this mismatch causes the log marker and second failure output to be wiped, breaking post-rerender classification.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1147-1151 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new class gate and the later classifier can disagree about whether rerender recovery should run.
  WHY: The reviewer says the gate checks the initial failure class while the classifier re-scans the log, so recovery decisions can diverge.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1221, 1261, 1269, 1287 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Missing output files and similar structural failures are classified as `non_lint`, which blocks recovery.
  WHY: The reviewer says these cases could be template-generation failures that deterministic rerender might fix, but the gate skips them.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py:338-380 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The embedded test copy of `attempt_render_recovery_after_preflight_failure` does not include the new `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` guard.
  WHY: The reviewer says the production function has the guard but the test mock does not, so the tests miss the new gating behavior.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1150-1153 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The `non_lint` skip behavior for structural failures appears intentional rather than a bug.
  WHY: The reviewer says missing generated artifacts should not be fixed by rerendering, so the consensus concern is likely working as designed.
- tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py:338-380 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: There is no direct test coverage for the new `PRE_FLIGHT_FAILURE_CLASS` gating behavior.
  WHY: The reviewer says the suite checks recovery success but does not verify the skip path for `non_lint` failures or the new class guard itself.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1231, 1271, 1279, 1297, 1373, 1678, 1754 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Multiple generated-artifact and scope-violation failures are classified as `non_lint`, which blocks deterministic rerender recovery.
  WHY: The reviewer says the new class gate only allows `lint`, so these recoverable generation problems now skip the self-heal path.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1242, 1259 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Syntax errors in `validate.sh` and `validate_driver.sh` are classified as `lint` even though rerender cannot fix them.
  WHY: The reviewer says the gate will waste a rerender attempt on files that are not regenerated by the template renderer.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1800-1803 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `classify_preflight_failure` classifies several missing/generated-artifact cases as `non_lint`, which blocks recovery through the class gate.
  WHY: The reviewer says the missing-artifact and zero-shell-script branches should be recoverable but currently route to `non_lint`, preventing rerender.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1194-1196 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fallback classification path can rescan the full log and match the earlier failure instead of the post-rerender one.
  WHY: The reviewer says falling back from an empty sliced log to the full log risks stale classification results and misleads recovery.
- tests/test_validate_process_render_recovery.py:340-380 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test stub does not include the new class guard or realistic classification behavior.
  WHY: The reviewer says the mock always returns `lint` and never exercises the skip-recovery path, so the new logic is untested.
=== END FINDINGS FROM stepfun_step-3_5-flash ===
